rows.en: With the dimensional distortion field down, even a kid could get in here!
If we don't hurry and bring peace back to Earth, we'll never be able to rebuild Planet Iga…
Let's show them what we can do!!
Leave it to Annie!
But please be careful! Nobody knows what these bioweapons called EATERs really are!
Steel Emperor Zephas…!
[HERO2]…
Geez… You had us worried sick!
Geez… You had us worried sick!
Steel Emperor Zephas! Show yourself!!
My son…
My son… I have been eagerly awaiting our reunion!
Why? What are you doing all this for!?

We meet after so long… and this is how you treat me?

Me, who gave you everything… Me, the omnipotent and omniscient being… Is this how you treat Steel Emperor Zephas!?

Because of you… my sister… my brother… and I myself…

Do you have any idea how much pain you put us through? Do you!?
My son… Are you crying?

My sister and my brother are dead! It's all, all your fault!

Before I kill you, I'll give you one word of warning!

Call off the Gaia Project, and leave at once without laying a single finger on this Earth or on humanity!!
What…? You intend to give me orders!?
Yeah… I'll say it as many times as it takes! Get out of here, now!

My son…

When you suddenly vanished one day, I ordered Atefarina to search for you all across the universe, you know?

For my beloved son, day after day, I searched!

Well, no matter… Someday you too will understand… this fatherly love of mine…

Fatherly love? Don't make me laugh!

Then tell me… When my sister died, and when my brother died… did you shed even a single tear?

My son…

Your sister and your brother lost their lives because they were led astray by worthless sentiment!

Let me teach you…

Humans are… truly foolish, selfish and ugly creatures! Yes, their hearts are filled to the brim with self-love.

My son…

You are now… at the very bottom of a deep, deep sorrow.

You lost your sister, you lost your brother… and you even lost your beloved Fadita. It must be so painful… so sad, isn't it?

But do not be mistaken…

When Atefarina died, when Apfaron died… and even when Fadita died, you could only cry for yourself.

For yourself, who can never see Atefarina again…

For the loneliness of never seeing Apfaron… or Fadita again… All of them are tears of pity for the self left behind!

Do you understand? Humans are pitiful creatures who can never shed tears for the sake of others…

My son… Wake up!

Your tears are not tears of pity for those who died. They are nothing but tears for your poor self, ruled by a powerful self-love!

And such a selfish human fights for justice? Ku ku ku… Isn't that a funny story?

My son…

You were merely shedding tears for your own sake, for the self that was left all alone!

In the end… you are no different from a beast ruled by self-love! But do not blame yourself…

There is nothing shameful about feeling self-love… All people cherish themselves!

Because without that self-love, all people would kill themselves…

Ku ku ku… Wake up! Face reality! Living for yourself is also the greatest weapon for protecting yourself!

Now, you understand, don't you?

If you swear your loyalty to me once more and serve Naager as the Black Knight Lucifard, I will spare your life and the lives of your friends…

But if you defy me…

I will kill you…!

…Just how rotten are you?

My sister said… even if he's being controlled by another life form, we can't let our father get away with this…

Humans have something that no one can steal, that no one can control!

And that is…

That is a heart that loves others!

No matter how you struggle, no matter what dirty tricks you pull… you can't steal people's hearts!

My sister…

Steel Emperor Zephas! She threw away her life to save you! No matter how much you reject it, my sister's love will pierce your heart!

Love is something you keep giving… never expecting anything in return! Giving and giving, even if it means sacrificing yourself, that's what love is!

Only a heart that respects people and loves people can give this Earth true peace! You have no one to love and no one who loves you, so you just can't understand that!
If you… still have a human heart left in you, then try and accept my sister's love!

Foolish son…

The greatest flaw of the Fusion Steel… is that the one who wields it is a human…

Even if one gains the mighty body of the Fusion Steel… as long as the higher animal fused with it is human, its power has natural limits!

That is exactly why… both Atefarina and Apfaron fell before you…

And why!?

Because, like you, they were swayed by foolish sentiment!

As you say, affection is a feeling too… But don't forget!

Heartlessness is a feeling too!

But… this EATER is different!

It completely takes over the nuclei of the cells it parasitizes! It is the ultimate combat bioweapon, with no emotions whatsoever!

Learn firsthand how much virtue and strength come from not being swayed by worthless emotions…
So that's an EATER…
My lovely EATER…! My ultimate combat bioweapon!? Defeated…!

What's wrong!? Is this all your so-called ultimate combat bioweapon amounts to?

Not being swayed by emotion is a virtue? Don't make me laugh!

In my heart, my sister and my brother… and [HERO4] are alive! I won't be killed by the likes of you!

What's wrong!? Is this all your so-called ultimate combat bioweapon amounts to?

Not being swayed by emotion is a virtue? Don't make me laugh!

In my heart, my sister and my brother… and [HERO4] are alive! I won't be killed by the likes of you!

The Fusion Steel… fuses with the EATER's Vol cells to become the perfect bioweapon…

And that is… the strongest Fusion Steel! The power of the armor I wear!!
So this is… Steel Emperor Zephas… your true form!?
So this is… Steel Emperor Zephas… your true form!?

My son…

This is your final chance… Will you not swear loyalty to me, to Naager?
Zephas! You're the one who needs to remember what a human heart is!
Zephas! You're the one who needs to remember what a human heart is!

If you absolutely refuse to obey, then it cannot be helped…

With these very hands, my son, I will kill you…!

Nuoooooh!!

I… defeated…!? I, the omnipotent and omniscient… the ruler of the entire universe!?

I, who was given the greatest power… Ngh… I, who am one of the chosen…!?
Director! A message from the assault team…
What!? And? What did they say?
"We have taken the space fortress! We will now destroy the power reactor!"
They did it…
What a bunch!
Director…

Mm…

Dr. Iwamoto! Please take care of that barrier.
Yes… Leave it to me!

If I destroy this power reactor, it'll all be over…

Sister… I'm sorry I couldn't lead Father down the right path…

Father's heart was more closed off than I thought… I thought your feelings and Brother's might get through to him, but it was no use…

[HERO4]… I never did a single thing for you, did I? Looking back, I feel like all I ever said to you were cold things…

If I'd known it would come to this… I would have been much, much kinder to you.

What kind of girl are you, really? You didn't know anything about Earth, so are you a girl from some other planet? But if I could…

…!?
Nuuugh…
Zephas…! You're still alive!?

Naager…

Uuugh… Fusion Steel that fills this fortress… Devour even my heart… …Devour everything, and grant my final wish!!

Gboh… Ngh… My final wish… Gboh… is… the Earth… burned in crimson flames…!! Gboh… Gboh…

…!?

What is this! Is this the true form of the thing that's been nesting inside Father!?

The one once called Zephas has fused with me!

Zephas's will is already gone… I shall carry out my purpose!

Carry out your purpose…?

No way…!? You intend to carry out the Gaia Project?

Heh heh heh… How foolish you humans are…!

There never was any Gaia Project to begin with.
What!? What do you mean?
Ku ku ku… That was nothing more than the wish of a worthless human named Zephas!

What!?

Then what is this space fortress for? Why has it stretched its tentacles deep underground and anchored itself here?
To culture Vol cells!

The place on this Earth best suited to culturing Vol cells is the ore deposits of an active volcano!

Because culturing Vol cells requires plenty of hydrogen sulfide as a nutrient source, and an ambient temperature of around 100 degrees Celsius…

For that… this Mount Fuji volcano was ideal!
Damn it… So you're saying Father was just being used by you too!?
Heh heh heh… That's not all!
That's not all?
That's not all?
The Vol cells have grown enough in this Earth's metal core! It's about time they fused with it.
What? Fuse with the Earth!?
What? Fuse with the Earth!?

There is nothing to be surprised about… It is the law of nature!

It is the process of the evolution of life, repeated countless times over five billion years…

You humans seemed to call me Number Ten… but from my point of view, your Earth is Number 2001!
What on earth are you…?

What on earth are you? From where I stand, you're no more than bacteria! A kind of vermin eating away at the planet…

I have survived by wandering from planet to planet, fusing again and again with planets rich in resources…

Since long before you were born… yes, since a mind-bogglingly ancient time…

If you are vermin, then act like vermin and share the fate of your host, this Earth… Ha ha ha!

Is there nothing we can do…!?

In a situation like this… how do we fight back? And how long will our energy even last…
[HERO2]… You must not hand the Earth over to Zephas Core!
Who are you…?
Who are you…?
I am Zoffy…

uncertain: U15972, U15977, U15996: 轟機鋼 is OCR for 融機鋼 (ゆうきこう per a reading elsewhere in the script); rendered 'Fusion Steel' - no glossary entry, other translators may differ
U15987: radio report put in double quotes as a quoted message
U16014: 50嬉年 read as 50億年 = five billion years
U15993: the closing question 'are you a girl from some other planet?' - 恵星 read as 惑星
